departments.label: Portal
departments.title: Portals
departments.pitch: Patch boundary portals for moving left, right, and mono signal lanes between rooms, templates, and larger circuits.

departments.label: Controller
departments.title: Controllers
departments.pitch: Input devices and control bridges for keyboards, MIDI, gamepads, and external gestures.

departments.label: Oscillator
departments.title: Oscillator
departments.pitch: Voices and raw tones: classic waves, tables, sync, supersaws, and other things that start a sound.

departments.label: Modulator
departments.title: Modulator
departments.pitch: Motion sources for pitch, amplitude, time, and texture. Small control engines that make patches move.

departments.label: Additive
departments.title: Additive
departments.pitch: Harmonic-stack voices: build timbre from partials, not a single waveform.

departments.label: Chaos
departments.title: Chaos
departments.pitch: All the various attractors and strange motion systems. The wild shelf where math starts looking back.

departments.label: Jerobeam
departments.title: Jerobeam
departments.pitch: Jerobeam spiral and orbit motion systems. Spiral Generator lives here.

departments.label: Noise
departments.title: Noise
departments.pitch: Noise, dust, instability, sparks, and all the useful mess a clean machine secretly needs.

departments.label: Drum
departments.title: Drum
departments.pitch: Rhythm machines, drum voices, pattern engines, and percussion control surfaces.

departments.label: Dynamics
departments.title: Dynamics
departments.pitch: Power routing, level control, offsets, and response shaping for keeping a circuit alive under pressure.

departments.label: Envelope
departments.title: Envelope
departments.pitch: Attack, decay, sustain, release, and gate-shaped motion. Make sound and visuals breathe on command.

departments.label: Scientific Filter
departments.title: Scientific Filter
departments.pitch: Textbook responses. Hz, order, clean controls — Passive, Active, Tilt, and other predictable spectral tools.

departments.label: Analog Filter
departments.title: Analog Filter
departments.pitch: Named character circuits. Timbre first — 303, Flower Child, SuperLove, and other engines with personality.

departments.label: Musical
departments.title: Musical
departments.pitch: Pitch, scale, and harmony tools: quantizers, chord pickers, progressions, and other note-theory building blocks.

departments.label: Space
departments.title: Space
departments.pitch: Delay, reverb, distortion, and performance processors for shaping finished sound.

departments.label: Time
departments.title: Time
departments.pitch: Clocks, sequencers, dividers, counters, and trigger timing — everything that decides WHEN the rest of the patch fires.

departments.label: Digital
departments.title: Digital
departments.pitch: Patch-local code surfaces, exact value conversion, and digital/visual programming tools inside the sandbox.

departments.label: Sample Player
departments.title: Sample Player
departments.pitch: Sample and music-file playback: one-shots, loops, and scrubbable players that turn stored audio into patch signal.

departments.label: Object
departments.title: Object
departments.pitch: Things you place in the world rather than wire into the signal path -- indicator lights, label plates, and other in-world props.

departments.label: RGB
departments.title: RGB
departments.pitch: RGB analog picture and vector faces — Pixel Grid, Vector RGB, and other color-path scopes.

departments.label: Shader
departments.title: Shader
departments.pitch: Screen-space shaders, color-space, image, and screen-wash modules — RGBA/HSLA, chroma, and stills.

departments.label: Oscilloscope
departments.title: Oscilloscope
departments.pitch: Dedicated display testbeds for trace, line burn, 2D scope, videoscope, and canvas-style waveform inspection.

departments.label: Multimeter
departments.title: Multimeter
departments.pitch: Readouts that are not waveforms: numbers, character grids, and other value/message faces for what the signal is saying right now.

departments.label: Debug
departments.title: Debug
departments.pitch: Inspection tools, sentinels, and safety monitors for catching bad values while a patch is under test.

departments.label: Invisible
departments.title: Invisible
departments.pitch: Not listed. Modules we are unsure about — hidden from the module browser for users and developers.

modules.label: Active Filter
modules.description: Scientific multipole ladder with optional drive—precise slopes plus bite.

modules.label: Additive Osc
modules.description: Build timbres from harmonics—use for organ-ish, bell-ish, or carefully voiced spectra.

modules.label: AirClipper
modules.description: Not listed. Holding pen — unsure about this module.

modules.label: Alias Sine
modules.description: Raw sine that intentionally wraps past Nyquist—hear aliasing as a feature, not a bug.

modules.label: Allpass Filter
modules.description: Phase-only filtering for phasers, correction, and delay-ish lag without EQ.

modules.label: Animated Text Box
modules.description: Wireable title/text plate so messages can be driven by the patch.

modules.label: Antisaw
modules.description: Cooked “aliasing on purpose” saw color—fold Nyquist junk into musical in-band grit.

modules.label: Archimedes
modules.description: Cheap quadrature sine/cosine pair (and a novelty π readout) for modulation and math demos.

modules.label: Arp
modules.description: Placeholder Arp — classic note arpeggiator for held chords / pitch CV (under construction).

modules.label: Asciiscope
modules.description: Under construction. XY character-grid phosphor is parked and cannot be dragged into the modular area.

modules.label: Attack Decay
modules.description: Simple A/D envelope (loop/LFO options)—default easy amp/mod shape.

modules.label: Attenuverter
modules.description: Scale and invert a signal, then add offset. Amplitude −1…+1 (0 mute, +1 unity, −1 invert).

modules.label: Input
modules.description: Bring the live mic/line into the patch as Mono, Left, Right.

modules.label: Music Player
modules.description: Play music files with scrub/phasor control—loops, stems, and timelines.

modules.label: B2U
modules.description: Bipolar −1…1 to unipolar 0…1 (out = (in + 1) / 2).

modules.label: BADVAL Monitor
modules.description: Watch for NaN/inf/explosions—show when the circuit goes invalid.

modules.label: Bandpass Filter
modules.description: Resonant pitched bandpass for formants, peaks, and ringing filters.

modules.label: Bessel Filter
modules.description: Soft Bessel multipole when you want less ringing and gentler time smear.

modules.label: Bessel-Thomson Filter
modules.description: Placeholder Bessel–Thomson filter — maximally flat group delay (Thomson).

modules.label: Bias
modules.description: Nudge a signal off center—steer bipolar CV into a new range.

modules.label: Binary Clock
modules.description: Placeholder binary counter with bit outs.

modules.label: BitConverter
modules.description: Bridge integer bitmasks ↔ CV so digital key masks can modulate audio-rate paths.

modules.label: BLIT
modules.description: Band-limited impulse-train tones for classic digital waves that stay sharp but controlled.

modules.label: Bloom & Glow
modules.description: Drive bloom/glow/dim of the screen wash from control signals.

modules.label: Jerobeam Blubb
modules.description: Placeholder Jerobeam Blubb motion—reserved for future path engine.

modules.label: Bode Shifter
modules.description: Frequency shift (not pitch shift)—metallic, inharmonic, bubbly spectra.

modules.label: Jerobeam Boing
modules.description: Placeholder Jerobeam Boing motion—reserved for future bounce/path engine.

modules.label: Bradley 2A Jitter/Hit Synth
modules.description: Broken-line test tone: add jitter, hits, dropouts, and interference for character and stress tests.

modules.label: Bug Button
modules.description: Resizable character button with down/up spikes, held and hover gates, and bipolar pointer X/Y outputs.

modules.label: Butterworth Filter
modules.description: Clean multipole LP/HP/BP/BR. Fine for a simple two-way split (pair LP+HP yourself); for 3+ bands use 3–6 Crossover.

modules.label: Button Events
modules.description: Website/UI clicks as patch pulses—hook page UX into the graph.

modules.label: Canvas
modules.description: Layer images, scopes, and shaders into one composite surface.

modules.label: Chaosfly
modules.description: Placeholder Chaosfly attractor—fly-like chaotic X/Y/Z motion (under construction).

modules.label: Chaotic Phase Locking Filter
modules.description: Phase-locked chaotic feedback textures through LP/HP stages.

modules.label: Chebyshev Filter
modules.description: Steeper multipole with musical edge—more bite than Butterworth.

modules.label: Chord Memory
modules.description: Capture a chord stack from monophonic pitch and walk or mutate the latched notes.

modules.label: Chord Pad
modules.description: Pick diatonic chords fast and feed Scale/Root/Gate into quantizers and musical engines.

modules.label: Chord Sequencer
modules.description: Clock through progressions for automatic harmony that drives the rest of the pitch chain.

modules.label: Chorus
modules.description: Placeholder multi-voice chorus thickening.

modules.label: Chroma Color
modules.description: Stylized chroma wash with drift/spread for mood lighting.

modules.label: Chua Attractor
modules.description: Double-scroll chaos with a different lobe feel than Lorenz—another chaotic CV palette.

modules.label: Clipper Limiter
modules.description: Drive with Gain, then Soft Clip last: below Min dB is dry; Min→Max is the shared Soft Clipper tanh knee (wider span = more gradual).

modules.label: Clock
modules.description: Free-running pulse clock to drive sequencers, envelopes, and rhythmic events.

modules.label: Clock Divider
modules.description: Slow a clock down for subdivisions—half-time gates, bar pulses, lazy LFOs.

modules.label: Codeblock
modules.description: Write JS DSP inline when no stock module does the exact math you need.

modules.label: Comb Resonator
modules.description: Pitch-tuned comb/KS-style resonance for plucks, hollow bodies, and harmonic peaks.

modules.label: Comparator
modules.description: Detect rises/falls and polarity—edge triggers, change detect, and sign gates.

modules.label: Multi Stage Filter
modules.description: Stack RBJ biquads for steeper multi-stage slopes when one band isn’t enough.

modules.label: 2-Crossover
modules.description: Dedicated 2-way Linkwitz–Riley split (low/high outs that recombine flat). LR/Butterworth alone also work for a simple two-way; prefer this for matched band outs.

modules.label: 3-Crossover
modules.description: Dedicated 3-way Linkwitz–Riley multiband split—use this (not hand-wired filters) for three or more bands.

modules.label: 4-Crossover
modules.description: Dedicated 4-way Linkwitz–Riley multiband split—use the Crossover modules for anything beyond a simple two-way.

modules.label: 5-Crossover
modules.description: Dedicated 5-way Linkwitz–Riley multiband split—prefer Crossover over stacking LR/Butterworth for multi-way work.

modules.label: 6-Crossover
modules.description: Dedicated 6-way Linkwitz–Riley multiband split—the full multi-band path when two-way LR/Butterworth is not enough.

modules.label: Curve Oscillator
modules.description: Play math curves (rose, Lissajous, etc.) as mono audio or X/Y scope art.

modules.label: Custom Display
modules.description: Draw a custom face with JS for patch-specific meters, art, or debug visuals.

modules.label: Degree Phrase
modules.description: Loop an 8-step degree phrase that can slowly mutate—aging riffs, not classic arps.

modules.label: Degree Turing
modules.description: Scale-degree Turing melody—mutate within a key instead of raw voltage.

modules.label: Delayed Trigger
modules.description: Wait after a hit, then fire—post-roll triggers, delayed envelopes, timed one-shots.

modules.label: Delay
modules.description: Modulated feedback delay for echoes, slap, and diffuse trails.

modules.label: Phosphor Dot
modules.description: Single soft phosphor dot for sparse, efficient level/position light.

modules.label: Drummer
modules.description: Placeholder Drummer — pattern/rhythm engine for the Sequence shelf (under construction).

modules.label: DSF Oscillator
modules.description: Alias-free DSF kit (sine/saw/PWM/etc.) for clean digital tones with classic PWM tools.

modules.label: ElectroHat
modules.description: Placeholder classic electro hi-hat voice.

modules.label: ElectroKick
modules.description: Placeholder classic electro kick voice.

modules.label: ElectroSnare
modules.description: Placeholder classic electro snare voice.

modules.label: RoundShape
modules.description: Sine→square ellipse shapes for soft-to-hard tones and dual uni/bi X/Y outs.

modules.label: Ellipsoid
modules.description: Full parametric ellipsoid path for rich 2D-scope-friendly oscillators.

modules.label: Elliptic Filter
modules.description: Aggressive multipole tone color (approx elliptic)—sharp, not lab-true Cauer.

modules.label: E.Piano (5)
modules.description: Placeholder GM Electric Piano 1 (program 5) sample/MIDI voice (under construction).

modules.label: EQ Filter
modules.description: Zero-latency multipurpose EQ band (LP/HP/peak/shelf…) for clean tone fixes.

modules.label: Evolve Field
modules.description: Under construction. Reserved for an eventual noise flow-field experiment (full-plate evolving noise / flow — not Julia / kaleidoscope).

modules.label: Curve Envelope
modules.description: Full DADSR curve envelope for long articulations and looped contours.
notes: prefer Attack Decay for simple AD

modules.label: Fractal Brownian Field
modules.description: Value-noise fBm field (native WASM). Face and X/Y/Z share one domain mapping (Scroll / Volume). WebGL only presents the mono grid + gradient.

modules.label: Flanger
modules.description: Placeholder classic short-delay flanger FX.

modules.label: Flex Grid
modules.description: Placeholder flexible multi-point control grid for morphing CV shapes (under construction).

modules.label: Envelope Follower
modules.description: Follow input loudness into CV—sidechain shapes and dynamics rides.

modules.label: Flower Child Filter
modules.description: Character self-osc filter (clean/dirty/rev/downsample modes).

modules.label: Formant Filter
modules.description: Placeholder formant/vocal filter bank.

modules.label: Fractal Brownian Motion
modules.description: Layered fBm drift for natural multi-scale organic modulation.

modules.label: Fractal Spiral
modules.description: Self-similar fractal spiral motion when plain spirals feel too simple.

modules.label: Gain
modules.description: Scale and offset signals—level matching, bias shifts, and simple VCA-style control.

modules.label: Gain Bias
modules.description: Retired alias of Gain—use Gain (it already has offset).

modules.label: Mix
modules.description: Retired alias of Mix—use Mix.

modules.label: GPU Additive
modules.description: GPU additive voice when you want heavy harmonic stacks without maxing the audio thread.

modules.label: Gradient Vectorscope
modules.description: 2D trace with color along path length (not phosphor brightness). Optional 90° mid/side rotation.

modules.label: Smooth Graph
modules.description: Shape a control curve by points—map phasors/LFOs into custom response shapes.

modules.label: Step Graph
modules.description: Stepped or free control graph when you want quantized X and shared curve tools.

modules.label: Gravity
modules.description: Placeholder few-body gravity for phosphor orbits (under construction). First piece of the Doppler module.

modules.label: Gravity Walker
modules.description: Stepwise scale walker with occasional leaps—melodies that prefer neighbors but escape ruts.

modules.label: Group Input
modules.description: Defines an exposed input on a saved module group. Rename it (right-click, module title alias) to name the port that appears on the group's own box.

modules.label: Group Output
modules.description: Defines an exposed output on a saved module group. Rename it (right-click, module title alias) to name the port that appears on the group's own box.

modules.label: Pitch Detector
modules.description: Track monophonic pitch: Hz, fidelity, and lock gate for analysis or follow.

modules.label: Henon Map
modules.description: Angular 2D digital chaos for spikier, more “computery” motion than continuous attractors.

modules.label: Hilbert
modules.description: Mono +90° / −90° phase shift (Hilbert Q). Wire Mid/Side Out Side here, add to Out Mid.

modules.label: Human Filter
modules.description: Bell-in-feedback dual-phasor network for vocal-ish, human filter colors.

modules.label: Hypersaw
modules.description: Massive phase-spread saw bank for dense stereo supersaw beds and visual phase columns.

modules.label: Image
modules.description: Hold a patch image asset for textures (e.g. phosphor dots).

modules.label: Inertial Filter
modules.description: Exponential attack/release approach in Hz—smooth catch-up without hard slew corners.

modules.label: Inv
modules.description: Invert a signal (out = −in).

modules.label: Jerobeam Kepler-Bouwkamp
modules.description: Nested polygon spiral for structured X/Y geometric patterns.

modules.label: MIDI
modules.description: Hardware MIDI in: pick a device and listen channel. Gate, note, velocity, and pitch CV.

modules.label: Keypad
modules.description: 12-key phone pad. Layout B (A/D in | pad | A/D/G/X/Y out). Index wraps. Behavior + Drag.

modules.label: Kick Envelope
modules.description: One-shot analog envelope: T trigger, A 0–1. Low/High range, Sharpness sine→square, Linear/Exponential curve.

modules.label: Knob
modules.description: Macro face control for one Bias value you want always visible and tweakable.

modules.label: Ladder Filter
modules.description: Lab ladder Mode×Stages surface—same multipole family, different UI.

modules.label: LED
modules.description: Signal light. Layout B (In | lamp | Out), resizable. Buffered In energy lights a Vector Dot (hue + brightness, smoothstep edge).

modules.label: Linear Envelope
modules.description: Predictable linear ramps for fades, gates, and simple motion.

modules.label: 1D Phosphor
modules.description: Heart-monitor 1D phosphor sweep—persistence trail for mono signals.

modules.label: Linkwitz-Riley Filter
modules.description: One LR-shaped LP or HP path—good for a manual two-way split. For 3+ bands with matched band outs, use 3–6 Crossover.

modules.label: Logistic Map
modules.description: One-knob chaos (R): steady → periodic → wild—great for CV and teaching chaos.

modules.label: Logarithmic Spiral
modules.description: Perfect equiangular spiral—constant growth look for clean geometric motion.

modules.label: Limiter
modules.description: Brickwall limiter with optional look-ahead and gain compensation (makeup −ceiling to 0 dBFS).

modules.label: Lorenz Attractor
modules.description: Butterfly chaos for organic X/Y trails, modulation, and never-quite-repeating motion.

modules.label: LUT Cell
modules.description: FPGA-style truth table + flip-flop—build custom digital logic and weird gate patterns.

modules.label: Macro Controls
modules.description: Eight always-on macros (M1–M8) for performance control of a whole patch.

modules.label: Mass-Spring-Damper
modules.description: Placeholder mass–spring–damper analog — 2nd-order mechanical resonator.

modules.label: Matrix Display
modules.description: Character plate for info/serial text with LCD-style residual.

modules.label: Matrix Waterfall
modules.description: Self-running matrix rain face—atmosphere and glyph aesthetics.

modules.label: Metallic Ratio
modules.description: Golden/silver/bronze ratios for detune spreads, delay lengths, or harmonic spacing.

modules.label: Midi Note Pitch
modules.description: Convert MIDI with octave/offset into pitch CV and frequency Hz.

modules.label: Midi Out
modules.description: Dial a fixed MIDI number as CV—static note sources and test pitches.

modules.label: Mid/Side
modules.description: Stereo → Mid/Side encode (0.5 matrix) for M/S processing and dual-bus routing.

modules.label: Min/Max
modules.description: Pick the highest and lowest of several signals—peak tracking, dual-range CV, or selector logic.

modules.label: Mix
modules.description: Sum several voices with per-channel level and bias—utility multivoice summing.

modules.label: MixStereo
modules.description: Four stereo pairs plus Mono into Mono/Left/Right, each pair with Volume and Pan, plus master Amplitude.

modules.label: Mode Resonator
modules.description: Ping a clean decaying mode—metallic rings and predictable resonance tails.

modules.label: Module Group
modules.description: Under construction. Nested patch box — grouping is not ready to spawn.

modules.label: Momentary
modules.description: Press-and-hold gate for triggers, rolls, and temporary enables.

modules.label: Jerobeam Mushroom
modules.description: Placeholder Jerobeam Mushroom motion—reserved for future path engine.

modules.label: Next Patch
modules.description: Trigger to load the next saved patch—setlist / kiosk navigation.

modules.label: Noise Detector
modules.description: Pitch-detector fidelity only: how tonal vs noisy the averaged L/M/R mix is, plus a threshold gate.

modules.label: Noise Generator
modules.description: Stereo noise colors (white/pink/brown/etc.) for texture, percussion, and dither.

modules.label: Note Glide
modules.description: Portamento/slew on 0.1V/oct so pitch moves slide instead of jump.

modules.label: Note Transpose
modules.description: Shift pitch by semitones/octaves after quantizers or before oscillators.

modules.label: Value LED
modules.description: Value LED: lit DSEG digits with Ghost/Trail residual hang + Burn sticky floor (app-wide residual policy). Side-mounted input, → thru for chaining. Search: value, LED, numeric display.

modules.label: Jerobeam NyquistShannon
modules.description: Placeholder Jerobeam Nyquist-Shannon motion—reserved for future path engine.

modules.label: BasicShape
modules.description: Everyday multi-wave starter oscillator with pitch CV—default voice for quick patches.

modules.label: Oscilloscope Bank
modules.description: Phase/amplitude bank view for multi-voice sources like Hypersaw.

modules.label: Output
modules.description: Final stereo sink—patch here to hear (and meter) the mix.

modules.label: Papoulis Filter
modules.description: Smooth lowpass with steeper roll-off than Butterworth for the same order.

modules.label: Passive Filter
modules.description: Real-pole LP/HP/BP with 6–24 dB slope, stagger spread, and optional −3 dB gain compensation.

modules.label: Patch
modules.description: Patch identity plate. Name, bank, program, tags, author, and description live here — one per patch.

modules.label: Percussion (10)
modules.description: Placeholder GM percussion / drum kit on channel 10 (under construction).

modules.label: Phase Disperse
modules.description: Cascade allpass smear—group-delay wash without changing magnitude.

modules.label: Phaser
modules.description: Placeholder classic modulated phaser FX.

modules.label: Phone Tone
modules.description: DTMF phone tones from Analog 0–1 and/or Digital slot (same 12-key map as Keypad). Gate opens the tone. Pitch Offset + 0.1V/Oct transpose both tones. Tone = sum. ƒ1/ƒ2 = pitched Hz. Analog/Digital Thru pass the ins.

modules.label: Phosphillator
modules.description: Placeholder Phosphillator — draw a shape and play it back as X/Y motion.

modules.label: 2D Phosphor (legacy)
modules.description: Legacy alias of 2D Phosphor—use scope2d for new patches.

modules.label: Ping Pong Delay
modules.description: Stereo bouncing delay with tempo tools and independent L/R motion.

modules.label: Pi Spigot Noise
modules.description: Live BBP four-phase π walk: Sum/Term audio, latched hex bits for rhythm. No digit file.

modules.label: Pitch Mod Wheel
modules.description: Read pitch bend and mod wheel next to the keyboard for expression.

modules.label: Pitch Quantizer
modules.description: Snap free pitch CV to a scale so walkers and LFOs land on musical notes.

modules.label: PixelGrid
modules.description: Play with pixel-grid looks—strokes, bevels, and lo-fi screen craft.

modules.label: PLL
modules.description: Lock a VCO to an input (Doepfer-style PLL)—tracking tones and lock gates.

modules.label: Pluck Envelope
modules.description: Fast pluck contour for picks, pings, and percussive decays.

modules.label: Plugin Input
modules.description: Clear stereo audio entry point when designing a plugin-style front end.

modules.label: Plugin MIDI In
modules.description: Keyboard/MIDI → gate, note, velocity, and 0.1V/oct for playable patches.

modules.label: Plugin MIDI Out
modules.description: Send/monitor MIDI note+gate for external gear or host MIDI outs.

modules.label: Plugin Output
modules.description: Clear stereo exit next to classic Output for host/plugin boundaries.

modules.label: Slider
modules.description: Vertical Bias control on the face—performance levels and slow rides.

modules.label: PolyBLEP
modules.description: Clean multi-wave oscillator when you want saw/square/tri/sine without harsh aliasing.

modules.label: Previous Patch
modules.description: Trigger to load the previous saved patch—setlist / kiosk navigation.

modules.label: Pulse Explosion
modules.description: On trigger, spray many micro-pulses over time—glitch rain and density hits.

modules.label: Quadrature
modules.description: IIR quadrature pair (I / +90° Q). Low-latency Hilbert-class phase tool — no host delay compensation.

modules.label: Jerobeam Radar
modules.description: Placeholder Jerobeam Radar motion—reserved for future sweep/path engine.

modules.label: Random Clock
modules.description: Irregular triggers with duty control—organic rhythm, humanized gates, surprise hits.

modules.label: Random Walk
modules.description: Controlled wander CV—smooth drift, steps, or filtered noise motion for parameters.

modules.label: Pixel Grid
modules.description: Analog RGB color-corrector and rolling framebuffer. Invert, contrast, brightness, and hue land on R/G/B/📺 outs.

modules.label: Ray Bouncer
modules.description: RS-MET Ray Bouncer in solid shell: particle reflecting inside an ellipse. Short Rs reset jack, X/Y phosphor face, full parameter bank below.

modules.label: Resonator Filter
modules.description: Chaotic dual-phasor resonator for wild FM-ish filter voices.

modules.label: Sabrina Reverb
modules.description: Sabrina reverb wash—diffusion, recycle, and mix for space.

modules.label: RGBA / HSLA
modules.description: Precise RGB/HSL screen wash color for intentional lighting.

modules.label: Soft Fractal
modules.description: Julia face with pure planetary c(t). Outs Hx/Hy = chaotic map z←z²+c. Depth = face iteration detail. No multi-sine wander — modulate C / Orbit Size / Orbit Speed / Speed externally.

modules.label: Picture
modules.description: Load an SVG or image onto the face (same idea as Knob face art). Width/height/x/y are center-based. In → Out passthrough. Pick the file in Display Settings.

modules.label: Shape
modules.description: Draw a gradient-colored shape on the face: position samples the gradient; width/height/x/y are center-based; shape choices include square, circle, triangle, star, diamond. In → Out passthrough.

modules.label: RobinSinusoid
modules.description: Ultra-cheap recursive sine when you want steady tone with almost no CPU cost.

modules.label: RobinSupersaw
modules.description: Detuned multi-saw wall with pitch dither—huge pads and trance supersaws.

modules.label: Rotation 3D to 2D
modules.description: Spin X/Y/Z points then project to 2D for scope art and stereo transforms.

modules.label: Sample Delay
modules.description: Precise dry/wet delay in time or samples for comb, predelay, or synced echos.

modules.label: Sample & Hold
modules.description: Grab a value on trigger and freeze it—stepped random, stepped automation.

modules.label: Sample Looper
modules.description: Gated stereo looping sample player with bounds, pitch, and seam crossfade.

modules.label: Sample Player
modules.description: One-shot stereo samples on trigger—hits, stabs, and short clips.

modules.label: Screen Visuals
modules.description: Drive screen shake, dim, color, and scope pause from the patch.

modules.label: 2D Phosphor
modules.description: X/Y phosphor energy trail—the standard attractor/laser-style path face.

modules.label: 2D Trace
modules.description: Instant X/Y vector history without phosphor—crisp 2D traces.

modules.label: Screen Space Shader
modules.description: Script custom screen effects from declared inputs.

modules.label: Shooting Star Explosion
modules.description: Website shooting-star hits as scaled triggers for FX or visuals.

modules.label: Shooting Star Tail
modules.description: Placeholder for shooting-star trail events.

modules.label: ⏱ Sim Time
modules.description: Shows how many sample-rate seconds have been processed (Planck 1e-7). A is a per-sample gate.

modules.label: Sinc
modules.description: Impulse-like sinc tones for modulation sources or teaching resampling / band-limit ideas.

modules.label: Sine Kick
modules.description: Analog sine kick: T fires a decaying sine. Pitch, Punch, Decay, Sharpness (sine→square). Out is audio; A is the envelope.

modules.label: Sinepulse
modules.description: Sine zap/chirp drum—electro kicks, risers, and swept sine hits.

modules.label: SinCos
modules.description: Straightforward pitchable sin/cos voice when you need a clean table sine with amplitude control.

modules.label: Slew
modules.description: Hard up/down rate limit with Lin / Log / Exp / Smooth curves for steps and CV glides.

modules.label: Snowflake
modules.description: Fractal turtle paths as stereo X/Y—ornamental motion and strange stereo voices.

modules.label: SoEmReverb
modules.description: Full SoEm reverb with echo modes, filters, ducking, and dry/wet stereo outs.

modules.label: Soft Clipper
modules.description: Gentle saturation/limiting when peaks need taming without hard digital clip.

modules.label: Softpop Oscillator
